    "reason": "The volume of dumped imports is a key factor in determining material injury."
  },
  "465": {
    "question": "Under R.A. No. 8800, within how many days from receipt of the Tariff Commission's recommendation shall the Secretary make a decision?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "15 days",
      "B": "15 working days",
      "C": "10 days",
      "D": "10 working days"
    },
    "correct": "A",
    "reason": "The Secretary must make a decision within fifteen (15) days from receipt of the TC recommendation."
  },
  "466": {
    "question": "What is the causal link in anti-dumping investigations?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "The connection between dumping and injury to the domestic industry",
      "B": "The relationship between exporters and importers",
      "C": "The impact of exchange rates on export prices",
      "D": "The correlation between export volume and market demand"
    },
    "correct": "A",
    "reason": "Causal link is the connection between dumping and the resulting injury to the domestic industry."
  },
  "467": {
    "question": "Which of the following choices is not an element of countervailing measures?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Injury",
      "B": "Like Product",
      "C": "Causal Link",
      "D": "Import Surge"
    },
    "correct": "D",
    "reason": "Import Surge is an element of safeguard measures, not countervailing measures."
  },
  "468": {
    "question": "What is a countervailing bond?",
    "choices": {

      "C": "A type of export subsidy",
      "D": "A financial guarantee for importers"
    },
    "correct": "B",
    "reason": "A countervailing bond is a security equal to the provisionally calculated subsidy amount."
  },
  "469": {
    "question": "What does the Tariff Commission determine in countervailing cases?",
    "choices": {

      "B": "The market price of the imported product.",
      "C": "The level of injury to the domestic industry.",
      "D": "The volume of imports."

    "reason": "The Tariff Commission determines the level of injury to the domestic industry in countervailing cases."
  },
  "470": {
    "question": "What is the purpose of the 'lesser duty rule' in anti-dumping investigations?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "To impose the highest possible duty on dumped imports",
      "B": "To limit the duty rate to the minimum necessary to prevent injury",
      "C": "To encourage domestic industries to compete globally",
      "D": "To promote free trade agreements"
    },
    "correct": "B",
    "reason": "The lesser duty rule limits anti-dumping duties to the minimum necessary to prevent injury."
  },
  "471": {
    "question": "Which law provides protection against dumped products in the Philippines?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Republic Act No. 8800",
      "B": "Republic Act No. 8751",
      "C": "Republic Act No. 8752",
      "D": "Republic Act No. 8753"
    },
    "correct": "C",
    "reason": "Republic Act No. 8752 is the Anti-Dumping Act of 1999."
  },
  "472": {
    "question": "How many days should the Tariff Commission complete its investigation and submit its report to the Secretary from receipt of the referral by the Secretary under R.A. No. 8800?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "60 working days from receipt of the referral",
      "B": "60 days from receipt of the referral",
      "C": "120 working days from receipt of the referral",
      "D": "120 days from receipt of the referral"
    },
    "correct": "D",
    "reason": "Under R.A. No. 8800, the Tariff Commission must complete its formal investigation and submit its report to the Secretary within one hundred twenty (120) calendar days from receipt of the referral (which may be shortened in urgent cases, but 120 days is the standard period)."
  },
  "473": {
    "question": "A country is experiencing an influx of subsidized steel imports. The domestic steel industry claims injury due to these imports. What steps should the government take to address this situation?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Impose a countervailing duty on all steel imports.",
      "B": "Investigate the existence of subsidies and injury.",
      "C": "Encourage domestic steel producers to reduce prices.",
      "D": "Ignore the issue as it doesn't impact consumers."
    },

    "reason": "The government must investigate the existence of subsidies and injury before imposing countervailing measures."
  },
  "474": {
    "question": "Within how many days should the Secretary of Agriculture come up with a finding from the receipt of a request from any person, whether natural or juridical, to verify if a particular product can be imposed a special safeguard duty subject to the conditions set in Section 21 of R.A. No. 8800?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "5 days",
      "B": "5 working days",
      "C": "30 days",
      "D": "30 working days"

    "reason": "The Secretary of Agriculture must come up with a finding within five (5) working days from receipt of the request."
  },
  "475": {
    "question": "What is the role of the Tariff Commission in anti-dumping investigations in the Philippines?",

      "C": "To represent domestic industries",

    "correct": "B",
    "reason": "The Tariff Commission investigates dumping practices and reports its findings in anti-dumping cases."
  },
  "476": {
    "question": "During a countervailing investigation, how can the government protect domestic industries from injury caused by subsidized imports?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Encourage consumers to buy local products.",
      "B": "Subsidize domestic industries further.",
      "C": "Impose provisional countervailing duties.",
      "D": "Reduce import quotas."
    },
    "correct": "C",
    "reason": "The government may impose provisional countervailing duties to protect domestic industries during investigation."
  },
  "477": {
    "question": "Which of the following forms of definitive safeguard measures is NOT mandated by R.A. No. 8800?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "A decrease in or imposition of a tariff-rate quota (MAV) on the product",
      "B": "A modification or imposition of any quantitative restriction on the importation of the product into the Philippines",
      "C": "An increase in, or imposition of, any duty on the imported product (such increase shall be subject or limited to the maximum levels of tariff (100%) as set forth in Section 1608 (a) of the CMTA)",
      "D": "One or more appropriate adjustment measures, including the provision of trade adjustment assistance."
    },
    "correct": "D",
    "reason": "Trade adjustment assistance is not a definitive safeguard measure; it is a separate support mechanism."
  },
  "478": {
    "question": "Which agency is responsible for imposing anti-dumping duties in the Philippines?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Department of Trade and Industry (DTI)",
      "B": "Bureau of Customs (BOC)",
      "C": "Tariff Commission",
      "D": "Department of Finance (DOF)"
    },
    "correct": "B",
    "reason": "The Bureau of Customs (BOC) is responsible for imposing anti-dumping duties."
  },
  "479": {
    "question": "A local electronics company faces stiff competition from subsidized imports. How can they demonstrate injury caused by these imports?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Show declining sales and profits.",
      "B": "Lowered their own prices.",
      "C": "Invested in marketing campaigns.",
      "D": "Sought government bailouts."
    },
    "correct": "A",
    "reason": "Declining sales and profits are evidence of injury caused by subsidized imports."
  },
  "480": {
    "question": "Under R.A. No. 8800 and its IRRs, which of the following is one of the four elements of general safeguards that should be established to warrant imposition of safeguard measure?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Level of subsidization",
      "B": "Price difference",
      "C": "Material injury or threat thereof",
      "D": "Import surge"
    },
    "correct": "D",
    "reason": "Import surge is one of the four elements of general safeguards under RA 8800."
  },
  "481": {
    "question": "A shipbuilding company suspects that foreign shipyards are receiving subsidies. What role does the Tariff Commission play in investigating this?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Determines the amount of provisional countervailing measure required.",

      "C": "Recommends subsidies for domestic shipyards.",
      "D": "Sets import quotas."
    },
    "correct": "B",
    "reason": "The Tariff Commission assesses the impact on local shipbuilders in countervailing investigations."
  },
  "482": {
    "question": "Which farm products are allowed to have a special safeguard measure applied if imports become too many (exceeding a set volume) or if their prices fall below a set level?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "All agricultural products under HS Chapter 1 to 24",
      "B": "Products marked 'SSG' in Schedule LXXV of the Philippines (GATT Schedule of Concessions)",
      "C": "Only on sensitive agricultural products, i.e., rice and sugar",

    "reason": "Special Safeguard (SSG) measures apply to products marked 'SSG' in Schedule LXXV."
  },
  "483": {
    "question": "From which source does a general safeguard measure pursuant to R.A. No. 8800 shall not be applied if the share of the total imports of the product is less than 3%?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "All sources",
      "B": "Developing countries",
      "C": "Third country",
      "D": "Domestic producers"
    },
    "correct": "B",
    "reason": "The de minimis exception for safeguard measures applies to developing countries with less than 3% import share."
  },
  "484": {
    "question": "Pursuant to Republic Act No. 8800 and its Implementing Rules and Regulations, to whom can an interested party file a request for special safeguard measures?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Secretary of the Department of Finance",
      "B": "Chairman of the Tariff Commission",
      "C": "Secretary of the Department of Trade and Industry",
      "D": "Secretary of the Department of Agriculture"
    },
    "correct": "D",
    "reason": "For agricultural products, requests for special safeguard measures are filed with the Secretary of Agriculture."
  },
  "485": {
    "question": "What is the purpose of the 'anti-circumvention' provision in anti-dumping investigations?",

      "A": "To prevent evasion of anti-dumping duties",
      "B": "To encourage fair competition",
      "C": "To facilitate cross-border investments",
      "D": "To promote foreign trade"
    },
    "correct": "A",
    "reason": "Anti-circumvention provisions prevent evasion of anti-dumping duties through transshipment or assembly."
  },
  "486": {
    "question": "If the domestic industry is suffering serious injury from a sudden increase in the imports of products like those being manufactured by them, which among the following trade remedy measure should be administered in order to rectify the injury?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Anti-Dumping",
      "B": "Countervailing Measure",
      "C": "Import Prohibition",
      "D": "Safeguard Measures"
    },
    "correct": "D",
    "reason": "Safeguard measures address serious injury from sudden import increases."
  },
  "487": {
    "question": "Which principle guides the determination of the 'constructed export price' in anti-dumping investigations?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Market-based pricing",
      "B": "Cost-based pricing",
      "C": "Arm's length transaction",
      "D": "Fair value pricing"
    },
    "correct": "C",
    "reason": "Arm's length transaction principle guides the determination of constructed export price."
  },
  "488": {
    "question": "What triggers the application of special safeguard measures?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Increased imports",
      "B": "Falling import prices",
      "C": "Both 'a' and 'b'",
      "D": "Injury to the domestic industry"
    },
    "correct": "C",
    "reason": "Special safeguard measures are triggered by both increased imports and falling import prices."
  },
  "489": {
    "question": "What is the purpose of the 'sunset review' in anti-dumping measures?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "To assess the impact of anti-dumping duties on consumers",
      "B": "To determine the duration of anti-dumping measures",
      "C": "To evaluate the continued need for anti-dumping duties",
      "D": "To review the performance of domestic industries"
    },
    "correct": "C",
    "reason": "Sunset review evaluates the continued need for anti-dumping duties."
  },
  "490": {
    "question": "A local textile industry claims that imports of cheap fabric from Country Y are causing injury. What factors would you consider?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Declining sales",
      "B": "Reduced profits",
      "C": "Layoffs in the domestic textile industry",
      "D": "All of the above"
    },
    "correct": "D",
    "reason": "Declining sales, reduced profits, and layoffs are all factors indicating injury to the domestic industry."
  },
  "491": {
    "question": "A case involves imported ceramic tiles. How would you determine if locally produced tiles are 'like products' for anti-dumping purposes?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "Check if they are produced by the same company.",
      "B": "Compare their prices.",
      "C": "Assess whether the imported and domestic tiles have closely resembling characteristics.",
      "D": "Based on the preference of buyers."
    },
    "correct": "C",
    "reason": "Like products are determined by whether imported and domestic products have closely resembling characteristics."
  },
  "492": {
    "question": "When can special safeguard measures be invoked?",
    "choices": {
      "A": "When import volume exceeds a trigger level",

  "1301": {

        "node_number": "200",
        "title": "Chief Officials of the Bureau",
        "content": "The Bureau shall be headed by a Commissioner and shall be assisted by at least four (4) but not more than six (6) Deputy Commissioners.\n\nThe Commissioner shall be appointed by the President of the Philippines.\n\nThe Deputy Commissioners shall also be appointed by the President and at least majority of whom shall come from the ranks of the Bureau.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "201",
        "title": "Powers and Functions of the Commissioner",
        "content": "The Commissioner shall have the following powers and functions:",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "OCOM Memorandum No. 28-2023 (Delegation of Powers)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/2023-28-OCOM-MEMO.pdf"
          },
          {
            "reference_text": "CAO No. 06-2022 (Assignments and Designations)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/cao-06-2022-Assignments-Reassignments-and-Designations.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(a)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Exclusive and original jurisdiction to interpret the provisions of this Act, in collaboration with other relevant government agencies, subject to review by the Secretary of Finance;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(b)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Exercise any customs power, duties and functions, directly or indirectly;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(c)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Review any action or decision of any customs officer performed pursuant to the provisions of this Act;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(d)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Review and decide disputed assessments and other matters related thereto, subject to review by the Secretary of Finance and exclusive appellate jurisdiction of the Court of Tax Appeals (CTA);",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(e)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Delegate the powers vested under this Act to any customs officer with the rank equivalent to division chief or higher, except for the following powers and functions:\n(1) Promulgation of rules and regulations;\n(2) Issuance, revocation or modification of rulings; and\n(3) Compromise or abate of customs obligations.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(f)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Assignment or reassignment of any customs officer subject to the approval of the Secretary of Finance: Provided, That District Collectors and other customs officers that perform assessment functions shall not remain in the same area of assignment for more than three (3) years; and",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(g)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Perform all other duties and functions as may be necessary for the effective implementation of this Act and other customs related laws.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "202",
        "title": "Functions of the Bureau",
        "content": "The Bureau shall exercise the following duties and functions:",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(a)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Assessment and collection of customs revenues from imported goods and other dues, fees, charges, fines and penalties accruing under this Act;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(b)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Simplification and harmonization of customs procedures to facilitate movement of goods in international trade;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(c)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Border control to prevent entry of smuggled goods;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(d)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Prevention and suppression of smuggling and other customs fraud;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(e)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Facilitation and security of international trade and commerce through an informed compliance program;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(f)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Supervision and control over the entrance and clearance of vessels and aircraft engaged in foreign commerce;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(g)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Supervision and control over the handling of foreign mails arriving in the Philippines for the purpose of collecting revenues and preventing the entry of contraband;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(h)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Supervision and control on all import and export cargoes, landed or stored in piers, airports, terminal facilities, including container yards and freight stations for the protection of government revenue and prevention of entry of contraband;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(i)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Conduct a compensation study with the end view of developing and recommending to the President a competitive compensation and remuneration system to attract and retain highly qualified personnel, while ensuring that the Bureau remains financially sound and sustainable;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(j)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Exercise of exclusive original jurisdiction over forfeiture cases under this Act; and",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(k)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Enforcement of this Act and all other laws, rules and regulations related to customs administration.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "203",
        "title": "Annual Report of the Commissioner",
        "content": "The Commissioner shall submit to the President, the Congress of the Philippines and the NEDA an annual report on the performance of the Bureau, on or before March 31 of the following year.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "204",
        "title": "Promulgation of Rules and Regulations",
        "content": "The Commissioner, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Finance, shall promulgate rules and regulations for the enforcement of this Act. The Commissioner shall regularly prepare and publish an updated customs manual, and the rules, regulations and decisions of the Bureau. The Commissioner shall furnish the Congress of the Philippines, the NEDA and the Tariff Commission with electronic copies of department orders, administrative orders, circulars, and rules and regulations promulgated pursuant to this Act.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "CAO No. 02-2024 (Customs Dues, Fees, and Charges)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/2024CAO-02-2024_1.pdf"
          },
          {
            "reference_text": "CAO No. 07-2019 (Pre-Lodgement Control and Alert Orders)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/cao-07-2019-Pre-Lodgement_Control_Order_and_Alert_Order-up1.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "205",
        "title": "Copies of Goods Declaration",
        "content": "The Commissioner shall regularly furnish the NEDA, the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) and the Tariff Commission electronic copies of all customs goods declaration processed and cleared by the Bureau.\n\nUpon request, the Tariff Commission shall have access to, and the right to be furnished with copies of liquidated goods declaration and other documents supporting the goods declaration as finally filed in the Commission on Audit (COA).\n\nFor this purpose, the Bureau shall maintain electronic records of goods declaration and other documents supporting the declaration.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "title_number": "II",
    "title_title": "BUREAU OF CUSTOMS",
    "chapter_number": "2",
    "chapter_title": "CUSTOMS DISTRICTS AND PORTS OF ENTRY",
    "sections": [
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "206",
        "title": "Customs Districts",
        "content": "For administrative purposes, the Philippines shall be divided into as many Customs Districts as necessary, the respective limits of which may be changed from time to time by the Commissioner, with the approval of the Secretary of Finance.\n\nEach Customs District shall be supervised by one (1) District Collector, assisted by as many Deputy District Collectors as may be necessary. The choice of the location of a District Office, its business hours and the staffing pattern thereof, shall be based on the particular requirements of each district.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "CAO No. 04-2020 (Redefining Jurisdictional Limits)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/CAO_04-2020-Redefining_the_Jurisdictional_Limits_of_Zamboanga_and_CDO.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "207",
        "title": "Ports of Entry",
        "content": "All ports of entry shall be under the supervision and control of a Customs District. A District Collector shall be assigned in the principal ports of entry while a Deputy District Collector may be assigned to other types of ports of entry.\n\nThe principal ports of entry shall be located in Aparri, San Fernando, Manila, Manila International Container Port, Ninoy Aquino International Airport, Subic, Clark, Batangas, Legaspi, Iloilo, Cebu, Tacloban, Surigao, Cagayan de Oro, Zamboanga, Davao, Limay and such other ports that may be created pursuant to this Act.\n\nFor the effective enforcement of the Bureau's functions and without hampering business and commercial operations of the ports, sea ports and airport authorities and private ports and airport operators shall provide suitable areas for examination and for other customs equipment free of charge within a definite period of time, as agreed with private port and airport operations, if any.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "208",
        "title": "Power of the President to Open and Close Any Port",
        "content": "Upon the recommendation of the Secretary of Finance, the President may open or close any port of entry. Upon closure of a port of entry, the existing personnel shall be reassigned by the Commissioner, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Finance.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "209",
        "title": "Assignment of Customs Officers and Employees to Other Duties",
        "content": "The Commissioner, with the approval of the Secretary of Finance, may assign any employee of the Bureau to any port, service, division or office of the Bureau within the Bureau's staffing pattern or organizational structure, or may assign any employee other duties: Provided, That such assignment shall not affect the employee's tenure of office nor result in a change of status, demotion in rank and/or salary deduction.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "210",
        "title": "Duties of the District Collector",
        "content": "The District Collector shall have the following duties in their assigned Customs District:\n\nSubject to the supervision and control of the District Collector, the duties and functions of the District Collector may be delegated to the Deputy District Collector. The Deputy District Collector assigned to a sub-port shall be under the supervision and control of the District Collector of the corresponding principal port.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "CMO No. 31-2018 (Automated Lodgement)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/cmo-31-2018_Prelodgement_Control.pdf"
          },
          {
            "reference_text": "Draft CMO on AEDS Integration (Automated Export Declaration System)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Draft-CMO-AEDS-8-15-23.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(1)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Ensure entry of all imported goods at the customs office;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(2)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Prevent importation and exportation of prohibited goods;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(3)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Ensure legal compliance of regulated goods and facilitate the flow of legitimate trade;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(4)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Examine, classify and value imported goods;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(5)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Assess and collect duties, taxes and other charges on imported goods;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(6)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Hold and dispose imported goods in accordance with this Act;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(7)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Prevent smuggling and other customs fraud; and",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(8)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Perform other necessary duties that may be assigned by the Commissioner for the effective implementation of this Act.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "211",
        "title": "Temporary Succession of Deputy District Collector to Position of Acting District Collector",
        "content": "In the absence or disability of a District Collector or, in case of vacancy, the Deputy District Collector shall temporarily discharge the duties of the District Collector. Should there be no Deputy District Collector, the District Collector shall designate, in writing, a senior ranking customs officer to temporarily perform the duties of the District Collector. In case there are two (2) or more senior ranking customs officers with equal length of service, a drawing of lots shall be undertaken. The District Collector shall report the designation to the Commissioner within twenty-four (24) hours after the designation.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "212",
        "title": "Records to be Kept by Customs Officers",
        "content": "District Collectors, Deputy District Collectors, and customs officers acting in such capacities must maintain permanent records of official transactions and turn-over all records and official papers to their respective successors or other authorized officials. The records shall be made available for inspection by other authorized officials of the Bureau.\n\nIf required, the District Collector shall affix the official dry seal of the Bureau on all documents and records requiring authentication.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "213",
        "title": "Reports of the District Collector to the Commissioner",
        "content": "The District Collector shall report to the Commissioner any probable or initiated litigation within the Customs District and shall submit regular monthly reports on all district transactions.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "title_number": "II",
    "title_title": "BUREAU OF CUSTOMS",
    "chapter_number": "3",
    "chapter_title": "EXERCISE OF POLICE AUTHORITY",
    "sections": [
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "214",
        "title": "Persons Exercising Police Authority",
        "content": "For the effective implementation of this Act, the following persons are authorized to effect search, seizure, and arrest:\n\nAll officers authorized by the Commissioner to exercise police authority shall at all times coordinate with the Commissioner.\n\nGoods seized by deputized officers pursuant to this section shall be physically turned-over immediately to the Bureau, unless provided under existing laws, rules and regulations.\n\nFor this purpose, mission orders shall clearly indicate the specific name carrying out the mission and the tasks to be carried out.\n\nSubject to the approval of the Secretary of Finance, the Commissioner shall define the scope, areas covered, procedures and conditions governing the exercise of such police authority including custody and responsibility for the seized goods. The rules and regulations to this effect shall be furnished to the concerned government agencies and personnel for guidance and compliance.\n\nAll seizures pursuant to this section must be effected in accordance with the provisions on the conduct of seizure proceedings provided for in Chapters 3 and 4 of Title XI of this Act.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "CAO No. 10-2020 (Seizure and Forfeiture Proceedings)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/CAO-10-2020-Seizure-and-Forfeiture.pdf"
          },
          {
            "reference_text": "CAO No. 03-2019 (Customs Jurisdiction and Police Authority)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/cao-03-2019_Customs_Jurisdiction_and_Excercise_of_Police_Authority.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(a)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Officials of the Bureau, District Collectors, Deputy District Collectors, police officers, agents, inspectors and guards of the Bureau;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(b)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Upon authorization of the Commissioner, officers and members of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and national law enforcement agencies; and",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(c)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Officials of the BIR on all cases falling within the regular performance of their duties, when payment of internal revenue taxes is involved.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "215",
        "title": "Place Where Authority May be Exercised",
        "content": "All persons exercising police authority as described in the preceding section shall only exercise powers within customs premises as provided for in Section 303 of this Act, and within the limits of the authority granted by the Commissioner.\n\nPort and airport authorities in all ports of entry shall provide authorized customs officers with unhampered access to all premises within their administrative jurisdiction.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          "Section 303"
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "216",
        "title": "Exercise of Power of Seizure",
        "content": "Any person exercising police authority under this Act has the power and duty to seize any vessel, aircraft, cargo, goods, animal or any other movable property when the same is subject to forfeiture or when they are subject of a fine imposed under this Act.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "217",
        "title": "Duty of Officer to Disclose Official Character",
        "content": "For the proper exercise of police authority, any authorized person shall disclose the nature of the authority upon being questioned at the time of exercise thereof and shall exhibit the corresponding written authority issued by the Commissioner.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "218",
        "title": "Authority to Require Assistance and Information",
        "content": "Any person exercising police authority may demand the assistance of and request information from the Philippine National Police (PNP), the AFP and other national law enforcement agencies, when necessary, to effect any search, seizure or arrest. It shall be the duty of any police officer and other national law enforcers to give such lawful assistance.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "219",
        "title": "Authority to Enter Properties",
        "content": "Any person exercising police authority may, at any time, enter, pass through, and search any land, enclosure, warehouse, store, building or structure not principally used as a dwelling house.\n\nWhen a security personnel or any other employee lives in the warehouse, store, or any building, structure or enclosure that is used for storage of goods, it shall not be considered as a dwelling house for purposes of this Act.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "220",
        "title": "Authority to Search Dwelling House",
        "content": "A dwelling house may be entered and searched only upon warrant issued by a Judge of a competent court, the sworn application thereupon showing probable cause and particularly describing the place to be searched and the goods to be seized.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "221",
        "title": "Authority to Search Vessels or Aircrafts and Persons or Goods Conveyed Therein",
        "content": "Any person exercising police authority under this Act may board, inspect, search and examine a vessel or aircraft and any container, trunk, package, box or envelope found on board, and physically search and examine any person thereon. In case of any probable violation of this Act, the person exercising police authority may seize the goods, vessel, aircraft, or any part thereof.\n\nSuch power to search includes removal of any false bottom, partition, bulkhead, or any other obstruction for the purpose of uncovering any concealed dutiable or forfeitable goods.\n\nThe proceeding herein authorized shall not give rise to any claim for damage caused to the goods, vessel or aircraft, unless there is gross negligence or abuse of authority in the exercise thereof.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "222",
        "title": "Authority to Search Vehicles, Other Carriers, Persons and Animals",
        "content": "Upon reasonable cause, any person exercising police authority may open and examine any box, trunk, envelope, or other container for purposes of determining the presence of dutiable or prohibited goods. This authority includes the search of receptacles used for the transport of human remains and dead animals. Such authority likewise includes the power to stop, search and examine any vehicle or carrier, person or animal suspected of holding or conveying dutiable or prohibited goods.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "223",
        "title": "Authority to Search Persons Arriving From Foreign Countries",
        "content": "Upon reasonable cause, travelers arriving from foreign countries may be subjected to search and detention by the customs officers. The dignity of the person under search and detention shall be respected at all times. Female inspectors may be employed for the examination and search of persons of their own sex.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "224",
        "title": "Power to Inspect and Visit",
        "content": "The Commissioner or any customs officer who is authorized in writing by the Commissioner, may demand evidence of payment of duties and taxes on imported goods openly for sale or kept in storage. In the event that the interested party fails to produce such evidence within fifteen (15) days, the goods may be seized and subjected to forfeiture proceedings: Provided, That during the proceedings, the interested party shall be given the opportunity to prove or show the source of the goods and the payment of duties and taxes thereon: Provided, further, That when the warrant of seizure has been issued but subsequent documents presented evidencing proper payment are found to be authentic and in order, the District Collector shall, within fifteen (15) days from the receipt of the motion to quash or recall the warrant, cause the immediate release of the goods seized, subject to clearance by the Commissioner: Provided, finally, That the release thereof shall not be contrary to law.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "CMO No. 19-2023 (Customs Districts Workflows for LOA)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/2024-02-OCOM-MEMO.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "title_number": "I",
    "title_title": "TITLE I – PRELIMINARY PROVISIONS",
    "chapter_number": "1",
    "chapter_title": "SHORT TITLE",
    "sections": [
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "100",
        "title": "Short Title",
        "content": "This Act shall be known as the \"Customs Modernization and Tariff Act (CMTA)\".",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "Bureau of Customs CMTA Full Text",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "title_number": "I",
    "title_title": "TITLE I – PRELIMINARY PROVISIONS",
    "chapter_number": "2",
    "chapter_title": "GENERAL AND COMMON PROVISIONS",
    "sections": [
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "101",
        "title": "Declaration of Policy",
        "content": "It is hereby declared the policy of the State to protect and enhance government revenue, institute fair and transparent customs and tariff management that will efficiently facilitate international trade, prevent and curtail any form of customs fraud and illegal acts, and modernize customs and tariff administration. Towards this end, the State shall:",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(a)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Develop and implement programs for the continuous enhancement of customs systems and processes that will harmonize customs procedures;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(b)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Adopt clear and transparent customs rules, regulations, policies and procedures, consistent with international standards and customs best practices;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(c)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Establish a regime of transparency and of accessibility to customs information, customs laws, rules, regulations, administrative policies, procedures and practices, in order to ensure informed and diligent compliance with customs practices and procedures by stakeholders;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(d)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Consult, coordinate and cooperate with other government agencies and the private sector in implementing and developing customs policy;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(e)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Provide a fair and expeditious administrative and judicial appellate remedy for customs related grievances and matters;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(f)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Employ modern practices in customs administration and utilize information and communications technology in the implementation of customs functions; and",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(g)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Institute professionalism and meritocracy in customs tax administration by attracting and retaining competent and capable customs officers and personnel to enforce the provisions of this Act.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "102",
        "title": "Definition of Terms",
        "content": "As used in this Act:",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [
          "definitions"
        ],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(a) Abatement",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Abatement refers to the reduction or diminution, in whole or in part, of duties and taxes where payment has not been made;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(b) Actual or Outright Exportation",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Actual or Outright Exportation refers to the customs procedure applicable to goods which, being in free circulation, leave the Philippine territory and are intended to remain permanently outside it;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(c) Admission",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Admission refers to the act of bringing imported goods directly or through transit into a free zone;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(d) Airway Bill (AWB)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Airway Bill (AWB) refers to a transport document for airfreight used by airlines and international freight forwarders which specify the holder or consignee of the bill who has the right to claim delivery of the goods when they arrive at the port of destination. It is a contract of carriage that includes carrier conditions, such as limits of liability and claims procedures. In addition, it contains transport instructions to airlines and carriers, a description of the goods, and applicable transportation charges;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(e) Appeal",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Appeal refers to the remedy by which a person who is aggrieved or adversely affected by any action, decision, order, or omission of the Bureau, seeks redress before the Bureau, the Secretary of Finance, or competent court, as the case may be;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(f) Assessment",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Assessment refers to the process of determining the amount of duties and taxes and other charges due on imported and exported goods;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(g) Authorized Economic Operator (AEO)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) refers to the importer, exporter, customs broker, forwarder, freight forwarder, transport provider, and any other entity duly accredited by the Bureau based on the World Customs Organization (WCO) Framework of Standards to Secure and Facilitate Global Trade, the Revised Kyoto Convention (RKC), the WCO Supply Chain Management Guidelines and the various national best practices to promote trade facilitation and to provide a seamless movement of goods across borders through secure international trade supply chains with the use of risk management and modern technology;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(h) Bill of Lading (B/L)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Bill of Lading (B/L) refers to a transport document issued by shipping lines, carriers and international freight forwarders or non-vessel operating common carrier for water-borne freight. The holder or consignee of the bill has the right to claim delivery of the goods at the port of destination. It is a contract of carriage that includes carrier conditions, such as limits of liability and claims procedures. In addition, it contains transport instructions to shipping lines and carriers, a description of the goods, and applicable transportation charges;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(i) Bureau",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Bureau refers to the Bureau of Customs;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(j) Carrier",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Carrier refers to the person actually transporting goods or in charge of or responsible for the operation of the means of transport such as airlines, shipping lines, freight forwarders, cargo consolidators, non-vessel operating common carriers and other international transport operators;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(k) Clearance",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Clearance refers to the completion of customs and other government formalities necessary to allow goods to enter for consumption, warehousing, transit or transshipment, or to be exported or placed under another customs procedure;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(l) Commission",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Commission refers to the Tariff Commission;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(m) Conditional Importation",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Conditional Importation refers to the customs procedure known under the RKC as temporary admission in which certain goods can be brought into a customs territory conditionally relieved, totally or partially, from payment of import duties and taxes; such goods must be imported for a specific purpose and must be intended for reexportation within a specified period and without having undergone any substantial change except due to normal depreciation;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(n) Customs Broker",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Customs Broker refers to any person who is a bona fide holder of a valid Certificate of Registration/Professional Identification Card issued by the Professional Regulatory Board and Professional Regulation Commission pursuant to Republic Act No. 9280, as amended, otherwise known as the \"Customs Brokers Act of 2004\";",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(o) Customs Office",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Customs Office refers to any customs administrative unit that is competent and authorized to perform all or any of the functions enumerated under customs and tariff laws;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(p) Customs Officer",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Customs Officer, as distinguished from a clerk or employee, refers to a person whose duty, not being clerical or manual in nature, involves the exercise of discretion in performing the function of the Bureau. It may also refer to an employee authorized to perform a specific function of the Bureau as provided in this Act;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(q) Customs Territory",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Customs Territory refers to areas in the Philippines where customs and tariff laws may be enforced;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(r) Entry",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Entry refers to the act, documentation and process of bringing imported goods into the customs territory, including goods coming from free zones;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(s) Exportation",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Exportation refers to the act, documentation, and process of bringing goods out of Philippine territory;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(t) Export Declaration",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Export Declaration refers to a statement made in the manner prescribed by the Bureau and other appropriate agencies, by which the persons concerned indicate the procedure to be observed for taking out or causing to be taken out any exported goods and the particulars of which the customs administration shall require;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(u) Flexible Clause",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Flexible Clause refer to the power of the President upon recommendation of the National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA): (1) to increase, reduce or remove existing protective tariff rates of import duty, but in no case shall be higher than one hundred percent (100%) ad valorem; (2) to establish import quota or to ban importation of any commodity as may be necessary; and (3) to impose additional duty on all import not exceeding ten percent (10%) ad valorem, whenever necessary;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(v) Foreign Exporter",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Foreign Exporter refers to one whose name appears on documentation attesting to the export of the product to the Philippines regardless of the manufacturer's name in the invoice;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(w) Free Zone",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Free Zone refers to special economic zones registered with the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA) under Republic Act No. 7916, as amended, duly chartered or legislated special economic zones and freeports such as Clark Freeport Zone, Poro Point Freeport Zone, John Hay Special Economic Zone and Subic Bay Freeport Zone under Republic Act No. 7227, as amended by Republic Act No. 9400; the Aurora Special Economic Zone under Republic Act No. 9490, as amended; the Cagayan Special Economic Zone and Freeport under Republic Act No. 7922; the Zamboanga City Special Economic Zone under Republic Act No. 7903; the Freeport Area of Bataan under Republic Act No. 9728; and such other freeports as established or may be created by law;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(x) Goods",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Goods refer to articles, wares, merchandise and any other items which are subject of importation or exportation;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(y) Goods Declaration",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Goods Declaration refers to a statement made in the manner prescribed by the Bureau and other appropriate agencies, by which the persons concerned indicate the procedure to be observed in the application for the entry or admission of imported goods and the particulars of which the customs administration shall require;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(z) Importation",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Importation refers to the act of bringing in of goods from a foreign territory into Philippine territory, whether for consumption, warehousing, or admission as defined in this Act;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(aa) Freight Forwarder",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Freight Forwarder refers to a local entity that acts as a cargo intermediary and facilitates transport of goods on behalf of its client without assuming the role of a carrier, which can also perform other forwarding services, such as booking cargo space, negotiating freight rates, preparing documents, advancing freight payments, providing packing/crating, trucking and warehousing, engaging as an agent/representative of a foreign non-vessel operating as a common carrier/cargo consolidator named in a master bill of lading as consignee of a consolidated shipment, and other related undertakings;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(bb) International Freight Forwarder",
            "title": null,
            "content": "International Freight Forwarder refers to persons responsible for the assembly and consolidation of shipments into single lot, and assuming, in most cases, the full responsibility for the international transport of such shipment from point of receipt to the point of destination;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(cc) Jurisdictional Control",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Jurisdictional Control refers to the power and rights of the Bureau in exercising supervision and police authority over all seas within the jurisdiction of the Philippine territory and over all coasts, ports, airports, harbors, bays, rivers and inland waters whether navigable or not from the sea;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(dd) Lodgement",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Lodgement refers to the registration of a goods declaration with the Bureau;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(ee) Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) refers to an entity, which may or may not own or operate a vessel that provides a point-to-point service which may include several modes of transport and/or undertakes group age of less container load (LCL) shipments and issues the corresponding transport document;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(ff) Outright Smuggling",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Outright Smuggling refers to an act of importing goods into the country without complete customs prescribed importation documents, or without being cleared by customs or other regulatory government agencies, for the purpose of evading payment of prescribed taxes, duties and other government charges;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(gg) Perishable Good",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Perishable Good refers to goods liable to perish or goods that depreciate greatly in value while stored or which cannot be kept without great disproportionate expense, which may be proceeded to, advertised and sold at auction upon notice if deemed reasonable;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(hh) Port of Entry",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Port of Entry refers to a domestic port open to both domestic and international trade, including principal ports of entry and subports of entry. A principal port of entry is the chiefport of entry of the Customs District wherein it is situated and is the permanent station of the District Collector of such port. Subports of entry are under the administrative jurisdiction of the District Collector of the principal port of entry of the Customs District. Port of entry as used in this Act shall include airport of entry;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(ii) Port of Discharge",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Port of Discharge, also called Port of Unloading, refers to a place where a vessel, ship, aircraft or train unloads its shipments, from where they will be dispatched to their respective consignees;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(jj) Reexportation",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Reexportation means exportation of goods which have been imported;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(kk) Release of Goods",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Release of Goods refers to the action by the Bureau to permit goods undergoing clearance to be placed at the disposal of the party concerned;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(ll) Refund",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Refund refers to the return, in whole or in part, of duties and taxes paid on goods;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(mm) Security",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Security refers to any form of guaranty, such as a surety bond, cash bond, standby letter of credit or irrevocable letter of credit, which ensures the satisfaction of an obligation to the Bureau;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(nn) Smuggling",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Smuggling refers to the fraudulent act of importing any goods into the Philippines, or the act of assisting in receiving, concealing, buying, selling, disposing or transporting such goods, with full knowledge that the same has been fraudulently imported, or the fraudulent exportation of goods. Goods referred to under this definition shall be known as smuggled goods;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(oo) Taxes",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Taxes refer to all taxes, fees and charges imposed under this Act and the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC) of 1997, as amended, and collected by the Bureau;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(pp) Technical Smuggling",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Technical Smuggling refers to the act of importing goods into the country by means of fraudulent, falsified or erroneous declaration of the goods to its nature, kind, quality, quantity or weight, for the purpose of reducing or avoiding payment of prescribed taxes, duties and other charges;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(qq) Tentative Release",
            "title": null,
