        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "430",
        "title": "Period of Limitation",
        "content": "In the absence of fraud and when the goods have been finally assessed and released, the assessment shall be conclusive upon all parties three (3) years from the date of final payment of duties and taxes, or upon completion of the post clearance audit.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "431",
        "title": "Release of Goods after Payment of Duties and Taxes",
        "content": "Goods declared shall be released when duties and taxes and other lawful charges have been paid or secured and all the pertinent laws, rules and regulations have been complied with.\n\nWhen the Bureau requires laboratory analysis of samples, detailed technical documents or expert advice, it may release the goods before the results of such examination are known after posting of sufficient security by the declarant.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "432",
        "title": "Release of Goods to the Holder of Bill of Lading or Airway Bill",
        "content": "Any customs officer who releases goods to the consignee or lawful holder of the bill of lading or airway bill shall not be liable for any defect or irregularity in its negotiation unless the customs officer has notice of the defect or irregularity.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "433",
        "title": "Release of Goods Without Production of Bill of Lading or Airway Bill",
        "content": "No customs officer shall release goods to any person without the submission of the bill of lading or airway bill covering the goods, except on written order of the carrier or agent of the vessel or aircraft, in which case neither the government nor the customs officer shall be held liable for any damage arising from wrongful release of the goods: Provided, That when the release of goods is made against such written order, the customs officer shall require the submission of a copy of the bill.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "434",
        "title": "Release of Goods Upon Order of Importer",
        "content": "An importer may issue a written authorization for the release of goods stored in a bonded warehouse to another person. Such authorization shall not relieve the importer from liability for the duties, taxes and other charges due on the goods unless the person to whom the release was authorized assumes such liability.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "435",
        "title": "Withholding Release Pending Satisfaction of Lien",
        "content": "When the District Collector is duly notified through a lawful order of a competent court of a lien for freight, lighterage or general average upon any imported goods, the District Collector shall withhold the release of the goods unless the claim has been paid or secured. In case of disagreement, the District Collector may release the goods after payment of the freight and lighterage due on the quantity or weight landed as actually determined.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "436",
        "title": "Fine or Surcharge on Goods",
        "content": "Goods subject to any fine or surcharge shall be released only after the payment of the fine or surcharge.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "title_number": "IV",
    "title_title": "IMPORT CLEARANCE AND FORMALITIES",
    "chapter_number": "4",
    "chapter_title": "SPECIAL PROCEDURES",
    "sections": [
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "437",
        "title": "Traveler and Passenger Baggage",
        "content": "The Bureau shall provide simplified customs procedure for traveler and baggage processing based on international agreements and customs best practices.\n\nTravelers shall be permitted to export goods for commercial purposes, subject to compliance with the necessary export formalities and payment of export duties, taxes and charges, if any.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "CAO No. 06-2020 (Baggage of Travelers and Crew)",
            "url": "https://www2.customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/CAO-06-2020_ConditionallyTaxDutyExemptImportation.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "438",
        "title": "Postal Item or Mail",
        "content": "Postal item or mail shall include letter-post and parcels, as described in international practices and agreements, such as the Acts of the Universal Postal Union (AUPU), currently in force.\n\nA simplified procedure shall be used in the clearance of postal item or mail, including the collection of the applicable duties and taxes on such items or goods.\n\nWhen all the information required by the customs are available in the special declaration form for postal items as provided in the AUPU or similar international agreements, the special declaration form and supporting documents shall be the goods declaration. However, a separate goods declaration shall be required for the following:",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "CAO No. 09-2020 (Clearance of Postal Items)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/CAO-09-2020.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(a)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Goods whose value fall within the level that the Commissioner has determined to be taxable and thus must be covered by a goods declaration;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(b)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Prohibited and regulated goods;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(c)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Goods, the exportation of which must be certified; and",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(d)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Imported goods under a customs procedure other than for consumption.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "439",
        "title": "Express Shipment",
        "content": "The Bureau shall provide simplified customs procedures based on international standards and customs best practices for air shipments considered as time-sensitive and requiring pre-arrival clearance. Express shipments of accredited air express cargo operators may be released prior to the payment of the duty, tax and other charges upon posting of a sufficient security.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "CAO No. 05-2020 (Clearance of Express Shipments)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/CAO_05-2020-Customs_Clearance_Procedures_on_Express_Shipments-1.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "440",
        "title": "Establishment of Advance Customs Clearance and Control Program",
        "content": "The Bureau may establish and implement a voluntary program on advance customs clearance and control on containerized cargoes. The details of the voluntary advance customs clearance shall be subject to the rules and regulations to be issued by the Bureau after conducting the necessary public hearings and consultations with the concerned sectors.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "title_number": "V",
    "title_title": "EXPORT CLEARANCE AND FORMALITIES",
    "chapter_number": "1",
    "chapter_title": "EXPORT CLEARANCE AND DECLARATION",
    "sections": [
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "500",
        "title": "Export Declaration",
        "content": "All goods exported from the Philippines, whether subject to export duty or not, shall be declared through a competent customs office through an export declaration, duly signed electronically or otherwise by the party making the declaration.\n\nThe description of the goods in the export declaration must contain sufficient and specific information for statistical purposes as well as for the proper valuation and classification of the goods.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "CAO No. 08-2020 (Export Cargo Clearance and Certificate of Origin)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/CAO_08-2020.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "501",
        "title": "Export Product to Conform to Standard Grades",
        "content": "If applicable, products shall conform to export standard grades established by the government. The packaging of the said goods shall likewise be labeled and marked in accordance with related laws and regulations. Export declaration may not be granted for goods violating the aforementioned requirements.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "502",
        "title": "Lodgement and Processing of Export Declaration",
        "content": "The Bureau shall promulgate rules and regulations to allow manual and electronic lodgement and processing of the export declaration.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "CMO No. 09-2026 (AEDS PLUS Automated Export Declaration System)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/2026CMO-09-2026.pdf"
          },
          {
            "reference_text": "CMO No. 54-2010 (Internet-Based Export Declaration / E2M)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/CMO-54-2010.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "503",
        "title": "Rules of Origin",
        "content": "Pursuant to the applicable rules of origin, the Bureau or any other designated government agency may determine the origin of goods for export and, if appropriate, issue the corresponding certificates of origin. However, the exporter may adopt a self-certification system: Provided, That it is duly accredited by the Bureau or any other authorized government agencies.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "title_number": "VI",
    "title_title": "CUSTOMS TRANSIT AND TRANSSHIPMENT",
    "chapter_number": "1",
    "chapter_title": "CUSTOMS TRANSIT",
    "sections": [
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "600",
        "title": "Customs Transit in the Customs Territory",
        "content": "Customs transit within the customs territory shall be allowed for goods except those intended for consumption, to be transported as follows:\n\nA transit permit is required for goods transported under customs transit. However, transfer of goods in customs transit from one means of transport to another shall be allowed: Provided, That any customs seal or fastening is not broken or tampered.\n\nThe party responsible for the compliance of the obligations imposed on customs transit shall ensure that the goods are presented intact and in due course at the customs office of destination. Failure to comply with the aforementioned obligations or likewise failure to follow a prescribed itinerary or period for delivery of the goods may immediately subject the goods to the corresponding duties, taxes and other applicable fines, penalties, and surcharges.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "CAO No. 12-2019 (Customs Transit in the Customs Territory)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/cao-12-2019-Transhipment_of_Goods.pdf"
          },
          {
            "reference_text": "CMO No. 27-2019 (Operational Guidelines for Customs Transit)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/ocom-memo-35-2020-Strict_Implementation_of_CMO_27-2019.pdf"
          },
          {
            "reference_text": "CMO No. 04-2020 (Electronic Tracking of Containerized Cargo / E-TRACC System)",
            "url": "https://www.google.com/url?sa=i&source=web&rct=j&url=https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/CMO-54-2010.pdf&ved=2ahUKEwid44bN5saVAxXVoK8BHfIwNbQQy_kOegYIAAgHEAQ&opi=89978449&cd&psig=AOvVaw2O3K0WQKUQjQSPQHEhPj-Q&ust=1783727960818000"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(a)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "From port of entry to another port of entry as exit point for outright exportation;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(b)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "From port of entry to another port of entry or inland customs office;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(c)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "From inland customs office to a port of entry as exit point for outright exportation; and",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(d)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "From one port of entry or inland customs office to another port of entry or inland customs office.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "601",
        "title": "Duty and Tax on Goods Intended for Transit",
        "content": "Transit goods admitted for storage in a customs bonded warehouse, or for outright exportation at the port of destination or inland customs office, and goods intended for transit covered by Republic Act No. 10668, otherwise known as \"An Act Allowing Foreign Vessels to Transport and Co-Load Foreign Cargoes for Domestic Transshipment and for Other Purposes\", shall not be subject to the payment of duties and taxes at the port of entry: Provided, That any conditions and security required by the Bureau are complied with.\n\nGoods for consumption and other goods intended for customs transit not covered by the immediately preceding paragraph shall be subject to the payment of duties and taxes at the port of discharge.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "AOCG Memo 168-2020 (Amended E-TRACC Guidelines)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/aocg-memo-168-2020-Amended_E-Tracc_Guidelines_for_PEZA_Import.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "602",
        "title": "Carrier's Security",
        "content": "Carriers that transport imported goods that shall be placed under customs transit from a port of entry to other ports, shall post a general transportation security amounting to at least fifty thousand pesos (P50,000.00). Such security shall ensure the complete and immediate delivery of goods to the customs officer at the port of destination and the payment of pertinent customs charges and expenses and other transfer costs. The amount of the security may be adjusted by the Commissioner, upon approval of the Secretary of Finance.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "title_number": "VI",
    "title_title": "CUSTOMS TRANSIT AND TRANSSHIPMENT",
    "chapter_number": "2",
    "chapter_title": "CUSTOMS TRANSSHIPMENT",
    "sections": [
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "603",
        "title": "Customs Transshipment",
        "content": "Goods admitted for transshipment shall not be subject to the payment of duties and taxes: Provided, That the goods declaration for customs transshipment particularly indicates such nature of the goods, duly supported by commercial or transport documents or evidence as required by the Bureau.\n\nGoods for transshipment must be exported from the Philippines within thirty (30) days from arrival thereof. The Commissioner may allow an extension of such period after the establishment of valid reasons.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          {
            "reference_text": "CMO No. 30-2019 (Operational Guidelines for Customs Transshipment)",
            "url": "https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/cmo-30-2019-Allowed_Fees_and_Charges_Imposed_and_Collected_by_the_BOC.pdf"
          }
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "604",
        "title": "Goods Entered for Immediate Reexportation",
        "content": "Where an intent of reexportation of the goods is shown by the bill of lading, invoice, manifest, or other satisfactory evidence, the whole or a part of a bill comprising not less than one package may be entered for immediate reexportation under security. The District Collector shall designate the vessel or aircraft in which the goods are loaded constructively as a warehouse to facilitate the direct transfer of the goods to the exporting vessel or aircraft.\n\nUnless it shall appear in the bill of lading, airway bill, invoice, manifest, or other satisfactory evidence, that goods arriving in the Philippines are destined for transshipment, no exportation thereof will be permitted except under entry for immediate reexportation under sufficient security in an amount equal to the ascertained duties, taxes and other charges.\n\nUpon the reexportation of the goods, and the production of proof of landing beyond the limits of the Philippines, the security shall be released.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "title_number": "VII",
    "title_title": "IMPORT DUTY AND TAX",
    "chapter_number": "1",
    "chapter_title": "BASIS OF VALUATION",
    "sections": [
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "700",
        "title": "Sequential Application of Valuation Methods",
        "content": "Imported goods shall be valued in accordance with the provisions of Section 701 of this Act whenever the conditions prescribed therein are fulfilled.\n\nWhere the customs value cannot be determined under the provisions of Section 701 of this Act, it is to be determined by proceeding sequentially through the succeeding sections hereof to the first such section under which the customs value can be determined. Except as provided in Section 704 of this Act, it is only when the customs value cannot be determined under the provisions of a particular section that the provisions of the next section in the sequence can be used.\n\nIf the importer does not request that the order of Sections 704 and 705 of this Act be reversed, the normal order of the sequence is to be followed. If the importer so requests but it is impossible to determine the customs value under Section 705 of this Act, the customs value shall be determined under Section 704.\n\nWhen the customs value cannot be determined under Sections 701 through 705, it may be determined under Section 706 of this Act.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          "Section 701",
          "Section 704",
          "Section 705",
          "Section 706"
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "701",
        "title": "Transaction Value System – Method One",
        "content": "The transaction value shall be the price actually paid or payable for the goods when sold for export to the Philippines adjusted in accordance with the provisions of this section: Provided, That:\n\nAll additions to the price actually paid or payable shall be made only on the basis of objective and quantifiable data.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          "Section 704",
          "Section 705"
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "Related Persons Criteria",
            "title": null,
            "content": "For purposes of this Act, persons shall be deemed related only if:",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": [
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(i)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "They are officers or directors of one another's business;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(ii)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "They are legally recognized partners in business;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(iii)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "There exists an employer-employee relationship between them;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(iv)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Any person directly or indirectly owns, controls or holds five percent (5%) or more of the outstanding voting stocks or shares of both seller and buyer;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(v)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "One of them directly or indirectly controls the other;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(vi)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Both of them are directly or indirectly controlled by a third person;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(vii)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Together they directly or indirectly control a third person; or",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(viii)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "They are members of the same family, including those related by affinity or consanguinity up to the fourth civil degree.",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "Sole Agent/Dealer",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Persons who are associated in business with one another in that one is the sole agent, sole distributor or sole concessionaire, however described, of the other shall be deemed to be related for the purposes of this Act if they fall within any of the eight (8) cases cited in the preceding paragraph.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "Related Party Sale",
            "title": null,
            "content": "In a sale between related persons, the transaction value shall be accepted as basis for customs valuation whenever the importer demonstrates that such value closely approximates one of the following occurring at or about the same time:",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": [
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(a)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The transaction value in sales to unrelated buyers of identical or similar goods for export to the same country of importation;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(b)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The customs value of identical or similar goods as determined under the provisions of Section 704 of this Act; or",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(c)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The customs value of identical or similar goods are determined under the provisions of Section 705 of this Act.",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "Additions to Price",
            "title": null,
            "content": "In determining the transaction value, the following shall be added to the price actually paid or payable for the imported goods:",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "Additions List",
            "title": null,
            "content": "The following shall be added:",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": [
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(1)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "To the extent that they are incurred by the buyer but are not included in the price actually paid or payable for the imported goods:",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": [
                  {
                    "node_type": "item",
                    "node_number": "(a)",
                    "title": null,
                    "content": "Commissions and brokerage fees except buying commissions;",
                    "status": "published",
                    "version": 1,
                    "keywords": [],
                    "cross_references": [],
                    "notes": [],
                    "children": []
                  },
                  {
                    "node_type": "item",
                    "node_number": "(b)",
                    "title": null,
                    "content": "Cost of containers;",
                    "status": "published",
                    "version": 1,
                    "keywords": [],
                    "cross_references": [],
                    "notes": [],
                    "children": []
                  },
                  {
                    "node_type": "item",
                    "node_number": "(c)",
                    "title": null,
                    "content": "Cost of packing, whether for labor or materials;",
                    "status": "published",
                    "version": 1,
                    "keywords": [],
                    "cross_references": [],
                    "notes": [],
                    "children": []
                  },
                  {
                    "node_type": "item",
                    "node_number": "(d)",
                    "title": null,
                    "content": "Value, apportioned as appropriate, of the following goods and services: materials, components, parts and similar items used in the production of imported goods; materials consumed in the production of the imported goods; and engineering, development, artwork, design work and plans and sketches undertaken elsewhere than in the Philippines and necessary for the production of imported goods, where such goods and services are supplied directly or indirectly by the buyer free of charge or at a reduced cost for use in connection with the production and sale for export of the imported goods; and",
                    "status": "published",
                    "version": 1,
                    "keywords": [],
                    "cross_references": [],
                    "notes": [],
                    "children": []
                  },
                  {
                    "node_type": "item",
                    "node_number": "(e)",
                    "title": null,
                    "content": "Amount of royalties and license fees related to the goods being valued that the buyer must pay either directly or indirectly, as a condition of sale of the goods to the buyer;",
                    "status": "published",
                    "version": 1,
                    "keywords": [],
                    "cross_references": [],
                    "notes": [],
                    "children": []
                  }
                ]
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(2)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Value of any part of the proceeds of any subsequent resale, disposal or use of the imported goods that accrues directly or indirectly to the seller;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(3)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Cost of transport of the imported goods from the port of exportation to the port of entry in the Philippines;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(4)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Loading, unloading and handling charges associated with the transport of the imported goods from the country of exportation to the port of entry in the Philippines; and",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(5)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Cost of insurance.",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "702",
        "title": "Transaction Value of Identical Goods – Method Two",
        "content": "Where the dutiable value cannot be determined under method one, the dutiable value shall be the transaction value of identical goods sold for export to the Philippines and exported at or about the same time as the goods being valued. For purposes of this section, \"Identical goods\" refer to goods which are the same in all respects, including physical characteristics, quality and reputation. Minor differences in appearances shall not preclude goods otherwise conforming to the definition from being regarded as identical.\n\nIf, in applying this section, more than one transaction value of identical goods are found, the lowest value shall be used to determine the customs value.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "703",
        "title": "Transaction Value of Similar Goods – Method Three",
        "content": "Where the dutiable value cannot be determined under the preceding method, the dutiable value shall be the transaction value of similar goods sold for export to the Philippines and exported at or about the same time as the goods being valued. For purposes of this section, \"Similar goods\" refer to goods which, although not alike in all respects, have like characteristics and similar component materials which enable them to perform the same functions and to be commercially interchangeable. The quality of the goods, its reputation and the existence of a trademark shall be among the factors to be considered in determining whether goods are similar.\n\nIf, in applying this section, more than one transaction value of similar goods are found, the lowest such value shall be used to determine the customs value.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "704",
        "title": "Deductive Value – Method Four",
        "content": "Where the dutiable value cannot be determined under the preceding method, the dutiable value shall be the deductive value unless otherwise requested by the importer as provided in Section 700 hereof. The deductive value which shall be based on the unit price at which the imported goods or identical or similar imported goods are sold in the Philippines, in the same condition as when imported, in the greatest aggregate quantity, at or about the time of the importation of the goods being valued, to persons not related to the persons from whom they buy such goods, subject to deductions for the following:\n\nIf neither the imported goods nor identical nor similar imported goods are sold at or about the time of importation of the goods being valued in the Philippines in the conditions they were imported, the customs value shall, subject to the conditions set forth in the preceding paragraph, be based on the unit price at which the imported goods or identical or similar imported goods sold in the Philippines in the condition they were imported and at the earliest date after the importation of the goods being valued, but before the expiration of ninety (90) days after such importation.\n\nIf neither the imported goods nor identical nor similar imported goods are sold in the Philippines in the condition as imported, then, if the importer so requests, the dutiable value shall be based on the unit price at which the imported goods, after further processing, are sold in the greatest aggregate quantity to persons in the Philippines who are not related to the persons from whom they buy such goods, subject to allowance for the value added by such processing and deductions provided under subsections (1), (2), (3) and (4) hereof.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          "Section 700"
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "Deductions",
            "title": null,
            "content": "The deductive value shall be subject to deductions for the following:",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": [
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(1)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Either the commissions usually paid or agreed to be paid or the additions usually made for profit and general expenses in connection with sales in such country of imported goods of the same class or kind;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(2)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The usual costs of transport and insurance and associated costs incurred within the Philippines;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(3)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Where appropriate, the costs of:",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": [
                  {
                    "node_type": "item",
                    "node_number": "(i)",
                    "title": null,
                    "content": "transport of the imported goods from the port of exportation to the port of entry in the Philippines;",
                    "status": "published",
                    "version": 1,
                    "keywords": [],
                    "cross_references": [],
                    "notes": [],
                    "children": []
                  },
                  {
                    "node_type": "item",
                    "node_number": "(ii)",
                    "title": null,
                    "content": "loading, unloading and handling charges associated with the transport of the imported goods from the country of exportation to the port of entry in the Philippines; and",
                    "status": "published",
                    "version": 1,
                    "keywords": [],
                    "cross_references": [],
                    "notes": [],
                    "children": []
                  },
                  {
                    "node_type": "item",
                    "node_number": "(iii)",
                    "title": null,
                    "content": "insurance; and",
                    "status": "published",
                    "version": 1,
                    "keywords": [],
                    "cross_references": [],
                    "notes": [],
                    "children": []
                  }
                ]
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(4)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The customs duties and other national taxes payable in the Philippines by reason of the importation or sale of the goods.",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "705",
        "title": "Computed Value – Method Five",
        "content": "Where the dutiable value cannot be determined under the preceding method, the dutiable value shall be the computed value of the sum of:\n\nThe Bureau shall not require or compel any person not residing in the Philippines to produce for examination, or to allow access to, any account or other record for the purpose of determining a computed value. However, information supplied by the producer of the goods for the purposes of determining the customs value may be verified in another country with the agreement of the producer and provided that said producer will give sufficient advance notice to the government of the country in question and that the latter does not object to the investigation.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "Computed Value Components",
            "title": null,
            "content": "The computed value is the sum of:",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": [
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(1)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The cost or the value of materials and fabrication or other processing employed in producing the imported goods;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(2)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The amount for profit and general expenses equal to that usually reflected in the sale of goods of the same class or kind as the goods being valued which are made by producers in the country of exportation for export to the Philippines;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(3)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The freight, insurance fees and other transportation expenses for the importation of the goods;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(4)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Any assist, if its value is not included under paragraph (1) hereof; and",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(5)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The cost of containers and packing, if their values are not included under paragraph (1) hereof.",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "706",
        "title": "Fallback Value – Method Six",
        "content": "If the dutiable value cannot be determined under the preceding methods described above, it shall be determined by using other reasonable means and on the basis of data available in the Philippines. If the importer so requests, the importer shall be informed in writing of the dutiable value determined under method six and the method used to determine such value.\n\nNo dutiable value shall be determined under method six on the basis of:",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "Prohibited Bases",
            "title": null,
            "content": "No dutiable value shall be determined under method six on the basis of:",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": [
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(1)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The selling price in the Philippines of goods produced in the Philippines;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(2)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "A system that provides for the acceptance for customs purposes of the higher of two (2) alternative values;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(3)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The price of goods in the domestic market of the country of exportation;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(4)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The cost of production, other than computed values, that have been determined for identical or similar goods in accordance with method five hereof;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(5)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The price of goods for export to a country other than the Philippines;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(6)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Minimum customs values; or",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(7)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Arbitrary or fictitious values.",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "707",
        "title": "Ascertainment of the Accuracy of the Declared Value",
        "content": "Nothing in this section shall be construed as restricting or calling into question the right of the Bureau to ascertain the truth or accuracy of any statement, document or declaration presented for customs valuation purposes. When a declaration has been presented and when the Bureau has reason to doubt the truth or accuracy of the particulars or of documents produced in support of such declaration, it may ask the importer to provide further explanation, including documents or other evidence, that the declared value represents the total amount actually paid or payable for the imported goods, adjusted in accordance with the provisions of Section 701 of this Act.\n\nIf in the course of determining the dutiable value of imported goods, it becomes necessary to delay the final determination of such dutiable value, the importer shall nevertheless be able to secure the release of the imported goods upon posting of a sufficient security in an amount equivalent to the duties and taxes in dispute conditioned on the payment of additional duties and taxes, if any, as may be determined: Provided, That prohibited goods shall not be released under any circumstance.\n\nIf, after receiving further information, or in the absence of a response, the Bureau still has reasonable doubts on the truth or accuracy of the declared value, it may deem that the customs value of the imported goods cannot be determined under method one, without prejudice to an importer's right to appeal pursuant to Section 1104 of this Act. Before taking a final decision, the District Collector shall communicate to the importer, in writing if requested, the grounds for doubting the truth or accuracy of the particulars or documents produced and give the importer a reasonable opportunity to respond. When a final decision is made, the Bureau shall communicate its decision and the grounds therefor in writing.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          "Section 701",
          "Section 1104"
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "708",
        "title": "Exchange Rate",
        "content": "For the assessment and collection of import duty upon imported goods and for other purposes, the value and prices thereof quoted in foreign currency shall be converted into the currency of the Philippines at the current rate of exchange or value specified or published, from time to time, by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "title_number": "VII",
    "title_title": "IMPORT DUTY AND TAX",
    "chapter_number": "2",
    "chapter_title": "SPECIAL DUTIES AND TRADE REMEDY MEASURES",
    "sections": [
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "709",
        "title": "Government's Right of Compulsory Acquisition",
        "content": "In order to protect government revenues against undervaluation of goods, the Commissioner may, motu proprio or upon the recommendation of the District Collector, acquire imported goods under question for a price equal to their declared customs value plus any duties already paid on the goods, payment for which shall be made within ten (10) working days from issuance of a warrant signed by the Commissioner for the acquisition of such goods.\n\nAn importer who is dissatisfied with a decision of the Commissioner pertaining to this section may, within twenty (20) working days after the date on which notice of the decision is given, appeal to the Secretary of Finance, and thereafter if still dissatisfied, to the CTA as provided for in Section 1136 of this Act.\n\nWhere no appeal is made by the importer, or upon reaffirmation of the Commissioner's decision during the appeals process, the Bureau or its agents shall sell the acquired goods pursuant to existing laws and regulations.\n\nNothing in this section limits or affects any other powers of the Bureau with respect to the disposition of the goods or any liability of the importer or any other person with respect to an offense committed in the importation of the goods.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          "Section 1136"
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "710",
        "title": "Marking of Imported Goods and Containers",
        "content": "(A) Marking of Goods. - Except as hereinafter provided, all goods of foreign origin imported into the Philippines or their containers, as provided in subsection (B) hereof shall be conspicuously marked in any official language of the Philippines as legibly, indelibly and permanently as the nature of the goods or container will permit and in such manner as to indicate to an ultimate purchaser in the Philippines the name of the country of origin of the goods. Pursuant thereto, the Commissioner shall, with the approval of the Secretary of Finance:",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(1)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Determine the character of words and phrases or abbreviation thereof which shall be acceptable as indicating the country of origin and prescribe any reasonable method of marking, whether by printing, stenciling, stamping, branding, labeling or by any other reasonable method, and in a conspicuous place on the goods or container where the marking shall appear;",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(2)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Require the addition of other words or symbols which may be appropriate to prevent deception or mistake as to the origin of the goods or as to the origin of any other goods with which such imported goods is usually combined subsequent to importation but before delivery to an ultimate purchaser; and",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(3)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Authorize the exception of any goods from the requirements of marking if:",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": [
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(i)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Such goods are incapable of being marked;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(ii)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Such goods cannot be marked prior to shipment to the Philippines without injury;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(iii)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Such goods cannot be marked prior to shipment to the Philippines, except at an expense economically prohibitive of their importation;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(iv)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "The marking of a container of such goods will reasonably indicate the origin of such goods;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(v)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Such goods are crude substances;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(vi)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Such goods are imported for use by the importer and not intended for sale in their imported or any other form;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(vii)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Such goods are to be processed in the Philippines by the importer or for the importer's account other than for the purpose of concealing the origin of such goods and in such manner that any mark contemplated by this section would necessarily be obliterated, destroyed, or permanently concealed;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(viii)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "An ultimate purchaser, by reason of the character of such goods or by reason of the circumstances of their importation, must necessarily know the country of origin of such goods even though they are not marked to indicate their origin;",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(ix)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Such goods were produced more than twenty (20) years prior to their importation into the Philippines; or",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(x)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Such goods cannot be marked after importation except at an expense which is economically prohibitive, and the failure to mark the goods before importation was not due to any purpose of the importer, producer, seller or shipper to avoid compliance with this section.",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(B)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Marking of Containers. - Whenever goods are exempt under paragraph (3) of this section from the requirements of marking, the immediate container, if any, of such goods, or such other container or containers of such goods, shall be marked in such manner as to indicate to an ultimate purchaser in the Philippines the name of the country of origin of such goods in any official language of the Philippines, subject to all provisions of this section, including the same exceptions as are applicable to goods under paragraph (3) of subsection (A).",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(C)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Fine for Failure to Mark. - If at the time of importation any good or its container, as provided in subsection (B) hereof, is not marked in accordance with the requirements of this section, there shall be levied, collected, and paid upon such good a marking duty of five percent (5%) of dutiable value, which shall be deemed to have accrued at the time of importation.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(D)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Release Withheld Until Marked. - No imported goods held in customs custody for inspection, examination, or assessment shall be released until such goods or their containers shall have been marked in accordance with the requirements of this section and until the amount of duty estimated to be payable under subsection (C) of this section shall have been deposited.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(E)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Abandonment Upon Failure to Mark. - The failure or refusal of the owner or importer to mark the goods as herein required within a period of thirty (30) days after due notice shall constitute as an act of abandonment of said goods and their disposition shall be governed by the provisions of this Act relative to abandonment of imported goods.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "711",
        "title": "Dumping Duty",
        "content": "The provisions of Republic Act No. 8752, otherwise known as the \"Anti-Dumping Act of 1999\", are hereby adopted.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          "Republic Act No. 8752"
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "712",
        "title": "Safeguard Duty",
        "content": "The provisions of Republic Act No. 8800, otherwise known as the \"Safeguard Measures Act\", are hereby adopted.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          "Republic Act No. 8800"
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "713",
        "title": "Countervailing Duty",
        "content": "The provisions of Republic Act No. 8751, otherwise known as \"An Act Strengthening the Mechanisms for the Imposition of Countervailing Duties on Imported Subsidized Products, Commodities or Articles of Commerce in Order to Protect Domestic Industries from Unfair Trade Competition, Amending for the Purpose Section 302, Part 2, Title II, Book I of Presidential Decree No. 1464\", otherwise known as the \"Tariff and Customs Code of the Philippines, as Amended\", are hereby adopted.",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [
          "Republic Act No. 8751",
          "Presidential Decree No. 1464"
        ],
        "notes": [],
        "children": []
      },
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "714",
        "title": "Discrimination by Foreign Countries",
        "content": "Without prejudice to the Philippine commitment in any ratified international agreements or treaty, the following recourse shall be applicable in case of discrimination by foreign countries:",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(a)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "When the President finds that the public interest will be served thereby, the President shall, by proclamation, specify and declare new or additional duties in an amount not exceeding one hundred percent (100%) ad valorem upon goods wholly or in part the growth or product of, or imported in a vessel of any foreign country whenever the President shall find as a fact that such country:",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": [
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(1)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Imposes, directly or indirectly, upon the disposition or transportation in transit or through reexportation from such country of any goods wholly or in part the growth or product of the Philippines, any unreasonable charge, exaction, regulation or limitation which is not equally enforced upon the like goods of every foreign country; or",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              },
              {
                "node_type": "subparagraph",
                "node_number": "(2)",
                "title": null,
                "content": "Discriminates in fact against the commerce of the Philippines, directly or indirectly, by law or administrative regulation or practice, by or in respect to any customs, tonnage, or port duty, fee, charge, exaction, classification, regulation, condition, restriction or prohibition, in such manner as to place the commerce of the Philippines at a disadvantage compared with the commerce of any foreign country.",
                "status": "published",
                "version": 1,
                "keywords": [],
                "cross_references": [],
                "notes": [],
                "children": []
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(b)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "If at any time the President shall find it to be a fact that any foreign country has not only discriminated against the commerce of the Philippines, as aforesaid, but has, after the issuance of a proclamation as authorized in subsection (a) of this section, maintained or increased its said discrimination against the commerce of the Philippines, the President is hereby authorized, if deemed consistent with the interests of the Philippines and of public interest, to issue a further proclamation directing that such product of said country or such goods imported in their vessels be excluded from importation into the Philippines.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(c)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Any proclamation issued by the President under this section shall, if the President deems it consistent with the interest of the Philippines, extend to the whole of any foreign country or may be confined to any subdivision or subdivisions thereof: Provided, That the President may, whenever the public interest requires, suspend, revoke, supplement or amend any such proclamation.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(d)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "All goods imported contrary to the provisions of this section shall be forfeited to the government of the Philippines and shall be liable to be seized, prosecuted and condemned in like manner and under the same regulations, restrictions, and provisions as may from time to time be established for the recovery, collection, distribution, and remission or forfeiture to the government by the tariff and customs laws. Whenever the provision of this section shall be applicable to importations into the Philippines of goods wholly or in part the growth or product of any foreign country, it shall be applicable thereto, whether such goods are imported directly or indirectly.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(e)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "It shall be the duty of the Commission to ascertain and at all times be informed whether any of the discriminations against the commerce of the Philippines enumerated in subsections (a) and (b) of this section are practiced by any country; and if and when such discriminatory acts are disclosed, it shall be the duty of the Commission to bring the matter to the attention of the President, and to recommend measures to address such discriminatory acts.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          },
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(f)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "The Secretary of Finance shall make such rules and regulations as are necessary for the execution of a proclamation that the President may issue in accordance with the provisions of this section.",
            "status": "published",
            "version": 1,
            "keywords": [],
            "cross_references": [],
            "notes": [],
            "children": []
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "title_number": "VIII",
    "title_title": "TAX AND DUTY DEFERMENT, PREFERENCE AND EXEMPTION",
    "chapter_number": "1",
    "chapter_title": "CONDITIONALLY TAX AND/OR DUTY-EXEMPT IMPORTATION",
    "sections": [
      {
        "node_type": "section",
        "node_number": "800",
        "title": "Conditionally Tax and/or Duty-Exempt Importation",
        "content": "The following goods shall be exempt from the payment of import duties upon compliance with the formalities prescribed in the regulations which shall be promulgated by the Commissioner with the approval of the Secretary of Finance: Provided, That goods sold, bartered, hired or used for purposes other than what they were intended for and without prior payment of the duty, tax or other charges which would have been due and payable at the time of entry if the goods had been entered without the benefit of this section, shall be subject to forfeiture and the importation shall constitute a fraudulent practice against customs laws: Provided, however, That a sale pursuant to a judicial order or in liquidation of the estate of a deceased person shall not be subject to the preceding proviso, without prejudice to the payment of duties, taxes and other charges: Provided, further, That the President may, upon the recommendation of the Secretary of Finance, suspend, disallow or completely withdraw, in whole or in part, any conditionally free importation under this section:",
        "status": "published",
        "version": 1,
        "keywords": [],
        "cross_references": [],
        "notes": [],
        "children": [
          {
            "node_type": "paragraph",
            "node_number": "(a)",
            "title": null,
            "content": "Aquatic products such as fishes, crustaceans, mollusks, marine animals, seaweeds, fish oil, roe, caught or gathered by fishing vessels of Philippine registry: Provided, That they are imported in such vessels or in crafts attached thereto: Provided, however, That they have not been landed in any foreign territory or, if so landed, that they have been landed solely for transshipment without having been advanced in condition;",
            "status": "published",
